observations: Sure payment, steady rate and no-tax assumptions appear before prediction comparing one thousand now with twelve hundred in three years at five percent.
Five-percent preset valued later payment at 1,037 today; seven percent gave 980 and reversed the preferred offer.
At zero rate, present value equaled nominal twelve hundred.
Screenshot distinguishes dashed future face value from solid current value. Reveal recalls original five-percent value 1,036.61, seven-percent 979.56 and approximate 6.27-percent crossover.
